Option.description: One selectable option on a `choice` or `multi` step.

description.description: Optional secondary text shown alongside the option label.

label.description: Human-readable button/select-option text shown to the user.

value.description: Stable machine value recorded in the answer when this option is chosen.

ReachPlan.description: Totals for a whole request: new threads, outside places, people tagged.

Step.description:
One screen of the wizard: a question plus how it is answered.

Accepts the shape a model actually writes as well as the canonical one.
Authored by an LLM at a tool boundary, and the canonical field names lose
every coin-flip against the prior set by other form APIs: `type` for
`kind`, `title`/`label` for `question`, plain strings for `options`, and
`single_choice`/`multi_select`/`free_text` for the enum's
`choice`/`multi`/`text`. A real session sent exactly that, collected 28
validation errors, retried with the same shape, and abandoned the form.
Rejecting it was defensible per-field and useless in aggregate, so the
aliases and coercions below absorb the difference instead.

allow_custom.description: Whether the user may add a free-text option alongside the listed options.

image_handle.description: File-store handle id previously returned by the image-generation tool -- a finished PNG, never a URL and never a diagram source. Anything that produces an image does so upstream, before the handle is attached here.

image_url.description: Server-populated; ignored when supplied by the caller.

key.description: Stable identifier for this step's answer; must be unique across the form. Omit it and a slug of the question is used.

kind.description: Whether this step is a single choice, a multi-select, or free text.

max.description: Maximum number of selections allowed on a `multi` step.

min.description: Minimum number of selections required on a `multi` step.

options.description: The selectable options for a `choice` or `multi` step. Unused for `text`. A plain string is accepted and becomes both the label and the value.

question.description: The question text shown to the user on this step.

StepKind.description: The three step shapes a wizard form can author.
